title_yt: If You Saved 2 Cents a Day Since 2013... #Shorts
title_fb: If you saved two cents a day since 2013, you could buy GTA 6
hook: If you saved two cents a day, you could buy GTA 6.
open_loop: Hook asks how two cents a day can buy GTA 6; paid off in the last ~7 s when Benny smashes the jar ($96.22 vs $79.99 game, $16.23 left). The mocking friend's 'it is too small' doubt is also paid off.
payoff: Two cents a day for 4,811 days is $96.22: enough for the $79.99 game with $16.23 left, while the friend who laughed is broke on launch day.

lines.text: If you saved two *cents a day, you could buy *GTA 6.
lines.say: If you saved two cents a day, you could buy G T A six.
lines.visual: Scene 1 at frame 0: Benny (everyday hoodie, coin prop) hops and holds up a coin with a smug smile; a big coin jar prop and headline '2 CENTS A DAY' already visible. Word 'GTA 6' lands as a plain text headline (no logo/art). Camera snap-zoom on 'GTA'.

lines.text: In *2013, Benny started a coin jar.
lines.say: In twenty thirteen, Benny started a coin jar.
lines.visual: Badge 'YEAR 2013'. Benny drops a coin into a big jar, clink sfx; jar is tiny and nearly empty. Stranger (hooded, friend) enters on the right.
Stranger (flip, point, smug) points at the jar and shakes with laughter; bubble 'HA HA HA' pops. Benny looks worried then determined; a coin bonks off Benny's head as a gag.

lines.text: Benny saved two cents *daily for thirteen years.
lines.say: Benny saved two cents daily for thirteen years.
lines.visual: Montage: Benny keeps dropping a coin, calendar-like counter runs from 2013 up to 2026 while the jar fills; coins rain behind. Benny hops, determined, then smug. Stranger stays in the back, bored, scrolling a phone.

lines.text: Game day came, and everyone was *broke.
lines.visual: Badge 'NOV 19, 2026'. Stranger slumps with expression broke and empty pockets; a bubble 'I AM BROKE!' with worried pose. Crowd panic gag: cash prop blows away. Benny stays calm with a smug look and the full jar next to him.

lines.text: Benny smashed the jar and found *ninety-six dollars.
lines.say: Benny smashed the jar and found ninety-six dollars.
lines.visual: Benny raises the jar, slams it down: stamp 'SMASH!', coins rain, flash on the cut. Counter counts up to $96.22 in gold; stranger shocked.

lines.text: He paid for the game and kept *sixteen dollars.
lines.say: He paid for the game and kept sixteen dollars.
lines.visual: Benny at the store counter hands cash across; a generic blank game box (no logo, no art) and badge '-$79.99'. Counter shows '$16.23 LEFT' in gold; confetti burst, Benny hero pose, happy expression.
Benny flex pose, smug, next to stack of coins; stranger slumped small behind him. Headline 'TINY HABITS WIN' in gold. Small badge 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE'.

lines.text: Would you save daily or *panic later?
lines.visual: Split picture: left Benny with jar (list row 'A  SAVE DAILY'), right stranger broke (list row 'B  PANIC LATER'). Benny points at the viewer, thinking expression.
Benny points at the viewer and smiles; headline 'COMMENT A OR B' in gold. Hard cut right after the last word.

facts_used.claim: GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026; Standard Edition is $79.99.
GTA 5 launched about Sept 17, 2013 (inferred from article dated Sept 20, 2013 saying $1B in 3 days). Spoken line says only 'since 2013'; do not show a Sept 17 date on screen.
Fans joke about '13 years since GTA 5' and about calling in sick for launch (hype that leaves people unprepared).

math_check: Python: Sept 17, 2013 to Nov 19, 2026 = 4,811 days (13.17 years). 4,811 x $0.02 = $96.22. $96.22 - $79.99 = $16.23 left. 1 cent a day would be only $48.11 (not enough, unused). $79.99 / 4,811 = $0.0166 per day (about 1.7 cents). Spoken numbers: 'ninety-six dollars' (96.22 rounded down) and 'sixteen dollars' (16.23 rounded down), both safe.
ip_notes: 'GTA 6' appears only as a spoken/written topic. No Rockstar characters, logos, wordmark, footage, art style or music. The game box is a generic blank cartoon box. City is plain cartoon, not palm-and-neon.
description_note: Add 'Not financial advice. Hypothetical example.' to the description. Hashtags: #gta6 #savingmoney #money.
